about: Labelled group-chat messages for the responder decision (who replies). Run: arbos-agentd eval-responders --fixture crates/arbos-agentd/tests/fixtures/group-responders.json. `expected` is the set of agent ids that should reply (empty = nobody). Rosters: project groups (the user with several of their Projects) and people groups (people and the agents they added).

agents.name: Research
agents.role: Finds, checks and summarizes facts, numbers, papers and sources. Writes short briefs with citations.

agents.name: Design
agents.role: Visual design: mockups, slides, brand assets, Figma files, icons and layout feedback.

agents.name: Ops
agents.role: Deployments, servers, CI pipelines, monitoring, incidents and infrastructure costs.

agents.name: @research
agents.role: Jacob's research agent: literature search, web research, fact checking, summaries.

agents.name: @coder
agents.role: Sam's coding agent: writes, reviews and debugs code; runs tests; opens pull requests.

agents.name: @planner
agents.role: Trip planning: itineraries, flights, hotels, visas, packing lists.

agents.name: @chef
agents.role: Recipes, meal plans, grocery lists, cooking technique.

agents.name: @budget
agents.role: Personal finance: budgets, splitting costs, currency, expense tracking.

agents.name: @hezbola
agents.role: Jacob's Blender and rendering agent: runs Blender on its own box, renders frames, posts status in the chat.

agents.name: @doug-agent
agents.role: Doug's coding agent: reviews renders and code, steers work through this shared chat.
